\subsection*{Part I --- Foundations (Beginner $\to$ CF 1800)}
\begin{tabularx}{\linewidth}{@{}c c >{\raggedright\arraybackslash}p{3.6cm} X@{}}
\toprule
& \textbf{Ch} & \textbf{Title} & \textbf{Patterns (solved problems)} \\
\midrule
\yes & 1 & Introduction to Arrays & Single-pass aggregates (Third Maximum Number, Advantage) $\cdot$ Read/write pointers: compacting in place (Move Zeroes, Remove Duplicates from Sorted Array II) $\cdot$ Reversal and rotation (Rotate Array, Check if Array Is Sorted and Rotated) $\cdot$ Simulation and index arithmetic (Plus One, Build Array from Permutation) $\cdot$ Frequency arrays over small values (How Many Numbers Are Smaller Than the Current Number, Unique Number of Occurrences) \\
$\circ$ & 2 & Prefix Sums \& Difference Arrays & Range sum queries (Static Range Sum Queries, Find Pivot Index) $\cdot$ Prefix sums with a hash map (Subarray Sum Equals K, Subarray Sums Divisible by K, Good Subarrays) $\cdot$ Difference arrays (Corporate Flight Bookings, Greg and Array) $\cdot$ Two-dimensional prefix sums (Range Sum Query 2D - Immutable, Maximum Side Length of a Square with Sum Less than or Equal to Threshold) $\cdot$ Prefix and suffix of other operations (Product of Array Except Self, XOR Queries of a Subarray) $\cdot$ Split points: cutting the array into parts (Number of Ways to Split Array, Three Parts of the Array) \\
$\circ$ & 3 & Hashing \& Counting & Complement lookups (Two Sum, Max Number of K-Sum Pairs) $\cdot$ Grouping by a transformed key (Same Differences, Equal Row and Column Pairs) $\cdot$ Distinct values and nearby duplicates (Distinct Numbers, Contains Duplicate II) $\cdot$ Majority voting (Majority Element, Majority Element II) $\cdot$ Set membership and remainders (Longest Consecutive Sequence, Make Sum Divisible by P) \\
$\circ$ & 4 & Two Pointers & Opposite ends on a sorted array (Two Sum II - Input Array Is Sorted, Container With Most Water) $\cdot$ Fix one, two pointers on the rest (3Sum, 3Sum Closest) $\cdot$ Merging and set operations on sorted arrays (Merge Sorted Array, Squares of a Sorted Array) $\cdot$ Greedy pairing (Boats to Save People, Number of Pairs) $\cdot$ Counting pairs with two pointers (Pair of Topics, Count the Number of Fair Pairs) $\cdot$ Runs of equal or consecutive elements (Summary Ranges, Alternating Subsequence) \\
$\circ$ & 5 & Sliding Window & Fixed-size windows (Maximum Average Subarray I, Maximum Points You Can Obtain from Cards) $\cdot$ Longest valid window (Max Consecutive Ones III, Books) $\cdot$ Shortest valid window (Minimum Size Subarray Sum, Minimum Operations to Reduce X to Zero) $\cdot$ Counting windows (Subarray Product Less Than K, Subarrays with K Different Integers) $\cdot$ Windows with a frequency table (Maximum Sum of Distinct Subarrays With Length K, Count Subarrays Where Max Element Appears at Least K Times) \\
$\circ$ & 6 & Sorting as a Tool & Sort, then scan neighbours (Minimum Absolute Difference, Honest Coach) $\cdot$ Custom comparators (Largest Number, Queue Reconstruction by Height) $\cdot$ Counting and bucket sort (Relative Sort Array, Maximum Gap) $\cdot$ Ranks and sorting by derived keys (Rank Transform of an Array, Sort Array by Increasing Frequency) $\cdot$ The median and exchange arguments (Stick Lengths, Minimum Cost to Make Array Equal) \\
$\circ$ & 7 & Binary Search on Arrays & Counting with bounds (Maximum Count of Positive Integer and Negative Integer, Find Target Indices After Sorting Array) $\cdot$ Nearest values in sorted arrays (Find K Closest Elements, Maximum Distance Between a Pair of Values) $\cdot$ Binary search on prefix sums (Eating Queries, Scuza) $\cdot$ A first search on the answer (Special Array With X Elements Greater Than or Equal X, Sum of Mutated Array Closest to Target) \\
